findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Enumerate scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py as a consumer: either confirm the reusable scanner mirror job runs OUTSIDE the gate's SOURCE_WORKFLOWS (test.yml/optionality.yml/verify-identity.yml/prompt-eval.yml) so no EXCLUDED_JOBS entry is needed, or add a justified EXCLUDED_JOBS entry for the advisory scanner job and account for that file edit in the recorded file impact.
evidence: scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py:44-49 SOURCE_WORKFLOWS = [test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml]
scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py:108-133: gating_job_names() treats every job not in EXCLUDED_JOBS as required in vote.needs; missing_gating_jobs() fails when vote.needs is not a superset
scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py:66-98 EXCLUDED_JOBS is the ONLY escape hatch, each entry justified
.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:147-152 runs `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` under the gate (so it fires on THIS change's own Verified vote)
test.yml:1 self-titles 'Test Suite (mirror)' — the natural host for 'mirror-CI wiring'
ABSENCE: the plan's file-impact/edit-set never mentions check_verify_gate_parity.py or an EXCLUDED_JOBS entry
findings.finding: The plan's mirror-CI wiring for the reusable scanner lane, combined with its advisory constraint that the lane stays out of gerrit-verify.yaml vote.needs, would trip scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py — which requires vote.needs to be a superset of every unconditional job in its SOURCE_WORKFLOWS (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml), failing the build for any such job absent from vote.needs unless it is listed in EXCLUDED_JOBS. This gate is an unenumerated consumer: the plan neither names check_verify_gate_parity.py as an edit target nor states where the scanner mirror job runs relative to SOURCE_WORKFLOWS.
findings.location: Scope bullet 'reusable scanner workflow plus mirror-CI wiring'; Advisory wiring constraint; AC 'The scanner lane is wired as advisory for Gerrit ... outside vote.needs'
scenarios: The scanner reusable is invoked as an unconditional job in a SOURCE_WORKFLOW mirror lane (e.g. test.yml) for visibility; make lint runs check_verify_gate_parity.py and fails because that job is not in vote.needs and not excluded — the advisory lane cannot land.
Reviewer cannot tell from the plan whether the mirror scanner job lives inside a SOURCE_WORKFLOW (gate trips) or a standalone workflow not tracked by the gate (gate passes).

evidence: Plan: 'a separate Gerrit exact-patchset advisory workflow (.github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml)' dispatched on 'patchset events'
gerrit-verify.yaml declares `permissions: contents: read / actions: read / checks: read` as its explicit read-only posture (lines 46-49)

ABSENCE: the plan never states the advisory workflow's `permissions` block or that it withholds secrets; untrusted patchset code executing in CI is the boundary, so the posture should be declared even though no secret asset is affirmatively introduced (minor/advisory per AMBIGUOUS-reachability fallback)
findings.finding: The plan introduces a new Gerrit advisory workflow (.github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml) that is dispatched on patchset-created and therefore checks out and executes lower-trust contributor patchset code in CI, but the plan does not declare the workflow's least-privilege posture (its `permissions:` block, and that it holds no secrets/write scope). The sibling gerrit-verify.yaml explicitly scopes itself to contents:read/actions:read/checks:read; the new lane crossing the same untrusted-code boundary should state an equivalent minimal, secret-free posture so a compromised patchset cannot reach voting credentials or write scopes.
